study: Exploratory robustness of frozen 224px-information and 28px-information ResNet-18 probes
models: Exactly the encoder, scaler, logistic coefficients and calibration cutoffs saved in reports/high_resolution; no refit, new selection or new threshold
cases: Same 621 internal test representatives; clean results already inspected, corrupted probe results not yet evaluated when this plan was committed
noise: Gaussian SD 0.1 in [0,1], clipped and rounded to uint8. Per original test index use default_rng(SeedSequence([42,index])); identical 224px noise field across branches.
noise_input: Primary perturbation: first form each clean branch at 224px, then add the same noise field at network input. This avoids suppressing noise by downsampling only the low-information branch.
noise_source: Secondary: perturb the shared 224px source before branch formation. Downsampling can suppress this noise in the low-information branch; this is intentionally a different pipeline, not equal effective noise severity.
relative_blur: Shared 224px source Gaussian filter sigma=8 pixels (1/28 of image width), reflect boundaries, then branch formation
quantization: Corrupted values clipped to [0,1], rounded to uint8 before encoder input or bicubic branch formation. Clean uint8 unchanged.
primary: Difference-in-differences at exactly 80% fractional-tie coverage: (native224 noise_input risk minus native224 clean risk) minus (low-information noise_input risk minus low-information clean risk)
secondary: All-condition risk-coverage, AUROC, NLL, Brier, ECE, original-cutoff coverage and accepted error. Paired high-minus-low differences are descriptive; no multiplicity correction.
scope: Paired image bootstrap conditional on encoder, two selected heads and cutoffs; no model-selection, patient-cluster or training uncertainty. Test already known, exploratory, not clinical validation.
